panel.title: Supertext translation
panel.notConfigured: Supertext is not configured yet. Ask an administrator to set the API key.
panel.noLocales: Add more locales under Settings → Internationalization to translate this entry.
settings.title: Supertext translation
settings.subtitle: Translate entries into other locales with Supertext AI.
settings.key.missing: No API key. Set SUPERTEXT_API_KEY on the server and restart Strapi.
settings.key.help: No Supertext account yet? <signup>Create one at supertext.com</signup>. Generate your API key at <key>supertext.com → Integrations → API</key> (requires the Admin role).
settings.languages.help: Every Strapi locale needs a Supertext code: a locale that is one (de-CH, fr-CH, es, zh-Hans) is used as it is; map the others (e.g. de → de-CH) with code under supertext.config.locales in config/plugins, where politeness sets formal or informal.
error.notConfigured: No Supertext API key configured. Set SUPERTEXT_API_KEY on the server. No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
error.authFailed: Authentication failed. Please check the Supertext API key. No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin. Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API; requires the Admin role).
error.notLocalized: This content type is not localized. Enable internationalization for it first.
error.notEnabled: Supertext translation is not enabled for this content type.
error.noTargets: Choose at least one target locale other than the source locale.
error.sourceMissing: No {locale} version of this entry found. Save it first.
error.forbiddenRead: You may not read the {locale} version.
error.forbiddenEdit: You may not edit these locales: {locales}
error.noFileId: Supertext did not return a file id.
error.failed: Supertext failed to translate the document.
error.limitExceeded: Your Supertext translation limit is exceeded.
error.fileDeleted: The Supertext file was deleted before it could be downloaded.
error.timeout: Timed out waiting for the Supertext translation.
error.notFound: The requested Supertext resource was not found.
error.invalidLanguagePair: Supertext does not support this language pair ({detail}). Check the locale's code in the plugin's locales setting (e.g. es, not es-ES).
error.tooLarge: The content is too large for Supertext to translate in one go.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests to Supertext. Please try again shortly.
error.unavailable: The Supertext service is currently unavailable.
keycheck.ok: API key checked: the connection to Supertext works.
keycheck.invalid: Supertext rejected the API key. Check that you copied the whole key, or generate a new one at <key>supertext.com → Integrations → API</key> (requires the Admin role). No Supertext account yet? Create one at <signup>supertext.com</signup>.
keycheck.missing: No API key is set yet. No Supertext account yet? Create one at <signup>supertext.com</signup>. Generate your API key at <key>supertext.com → Integrations → API</key> (requires the Admin role).
keycheck.unreachable: The API key couldn't be checked because Supertext can't be reached. The settings are saved; check again later.
keycheck.error: The API key couldn't be checked: Supertext answered with an error ({status}). The settings are saved; check again later.
settings.reports.help: Sends the site URL and the versions of this plugin, Strapi and the runtime to Supertext after an update and when the API key changes, so Supertext support can see which version you run. No content, no API key and no personal data are sent. Turn it off with versionReports: false in config/plugins or SUPERTEXT_VERSION_REPORTS=0.
settings.notMapped: Not mapped: set its code under supertext.config.locales
settings.noPoliteness: Supertext offers no formal/informal choice for this language
error.unsupportedLanguage: The language {language} has no Supertext language yet. Ask your administrator to map it (code under supertext.config.locales in config/plugins, e.g. de-CH).
error.unsupportedFeature: Supertext offers no formal or informal tone for the language {language}. Ask your administrator to remove its politeness option in config/plugins (default tone).
